integrity: The proof derives each local resolving neighborhood from distances, reduces the original vertex LP exactly to pairwise part-sum constraints, and solves that LP. An independent checker reconstructs graph distances and solves the original vertex LP through order ten.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns fractional local metric dimension only.
Optimal vertex weights within a part are not unique; only part totals are characterized.
Finite LP checks through order ten are corroborative only.
Search coverage cannot exclude an unindexed or differently phrased correction.
title: Correction and optimizer classification for fractional local metric dimension of complete multipartite graphs
